HOW TO PLAY

Guess the size.

Each game has 8 questions: 2 Easy, 4 Medium, and 2 Hard.

Enter your estimate and choose a unit. Your accuracy is the smaller measurement ÷ the larger measurement × 100.

That makes the scoring symmetrical: if the answer is 100, guessing 50 or 200 both earns 50% accuracy.

Easy×1 Medium×1.25 Hard×1.5

Your accuracy is multiplied by the question difficulty. A perfect game is exactly 1000 points.
